| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Select** `preset` | Sampled colors | Sampled colors, Highlights, Midtones, Shadows | What to select. Sampled colors uses the colors you click. The tone presets use brightness. |
| **Tolerance** `tolerance` | 0 | 0 to 255 | Color distance from a sample up to which a pixel is fully selected. |
| **Fuzziness** `fuzziness` | 40 | 0 to 255 | Extra color distance over which the selection fades from full to none. |
| **Color space** `colorSpace` | Lab | RGB, HSV, Lab | Where the color distance is measured. |
| **Localized colors** `localized` | off | On or off | Weight each sample by how near the pixel is to the place you clicked. |
| **Range** `range` | 25 | 1 to 100 % | For localized colors, how far a sample reaches, in percent of the longer image side. |
